id: title:Radu-Raicea:filter sentiment tab results in the query

review.posthog_relevance: Changes the AI Observability sentiment analysis UI, including the removal of the account filter switch, replacement of the deprecated 'both' sentiment filter with a negative default, and the addition of pagination and conditional loading actions.
review.reason: The chunk contains a cohesive group of changes to the AI Observability sentiment tab. P1.F1.H1 and P1.F1.H2 remove the account filter switch and clarify the separation of sentiment and generation filters. P1.F6.H9 replaces the global sentiment filter state with an evaluation-specific ID and removes the neutral category, changing the default behavior. P1.F6.H16 adds action handlers.
review.uncertainty: The chunk does not include the complete implementation of the sentiment evaluation selection and ranking changes; P1.F4 and P1.F5 hunks are missing. The tier is assigned based on the visible, substantive changes to the UI and state management, but the full behavior and validation are not demonstrated in this chunk.

observations.behavior: Adds two new action handlers, activeFilters and evaluationId, that trigger actions.loadGenerations() when the corresponding filter value exists and the component has loaded once.
observations.posthog_connection: This could allow the AI Observability sentiment analysis UI to refresh or complete generation loading when specific filter parameters are present, potentially supporting conditional loading behavior for sentiment analysis results.
